title: Breast cancer
subtitle: Management by receptor subtype (HR+/HER2−, HER2+, TNBC — and now HER2-low / ultralow) crossed with stage and setting · AJCC 8th anatomic + prognostic staging
source: Compiled from the Stanford Oncology Handbook 2025, Breast Cancer (Schultz C, Khan S, Sidhu K, Yang M, Dalal N, Tsai J) · NCCN · primary trial reports verified against PubMed, September 2026.

blocks.heading: Workup
items: Bilateral diagnostic mammogram + ultrasound; MRI or contrast-enhanced mammogram if dense tissue, young, or extent unclear
Core biopsy of breast (and suspicious node) with clip placement — clip the node before neoadjuvant therapy
ER/PR, HER2 (IHC, reflex ISH if 2+), grade, Ki-67 on every invasive cancer
Stage I–IIB: no routine staging imaging — CBC/CMP; bone scan, CT only for symptoms, raised alk phos or abnormal LFTs
Clinical stage III: CT C/A/P + bone scan, or PET/CT

Stage IV / recurrence: biopsy the first metastasis (receptors drift, HER2-low status can change); brain MRI for CNS symptoms · NGS on tissue or ctDNA for PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN/ESR1 · germline testing if not done
Fertility counseling before chemotherapy in premenopausal patients

blocks.heading: Staging — AJCC 8th
rows: a chest wall · b skin edema/ulcer/satellite nodules · c both · d inflammatory
1–3 / 4–9 / ≥10 axillary nodes (or infraclavicular, supraclavicular). pN1mi >0.2–2 mm; pN0(i+) ≤0.2 mm
fixed/matted axillary or IMN alone / infraclavicular, IMN + axillary, or supraclavicular

Grade, ER, PR, HER2 modify the anatomic stage — triple-negative is upstaged, HR+/HER2+ often downstaged. T1–2 N0 HR+/HER2− with Oncotype RS <11 → stage IA. Pathologic prognostic stage does not apply after neoadjuvant therapy
yc / yp prefix; pCR = ypT0/is ypN0 — drives adjuvant escalation
blocks.footnote: DCIS: lumpectomy + RT, mastectomy, or lumpectomy alone if small and age >70; margin ≥2 mm; ER+ → tamoxifen ×5 yr (NSABP B-24) or low-dose 5 mg ×3 yr. LCIS: florid/pleomorphic → excise to negative margins; classic does not need them.

blocks.heading: Local therapy
rows: Skip ALND (Z0011: 10-yr OS 86.3 vs 83.6%). AMAROS: axillary RT = ALND for control (10-yr axillary recurrence 0.93 vs 1.82%), half the lymphedema
SLNB can be omitted: SOUND (≤2 cm, 5-yr DDFS 98.0 vs 97.7%) · INSEMA (≤5 cm, BCS; 5-yr iDFS 91.9 vs 91.7%) — axillary recurrence slightly higher

PRIME II (HR+, N0, ≤3 cm, on ET): omitting RT raised 10-yr local recurrence 9.5% vs 0.9%, OS identical (80.8 vs 80.7%). EUROPA (≥70, luminal A): RT alone had better QoL than ET alone at interim — recurrence data pending
≥3 positive nodes, matted nodes, inflammatory/T4, node-positive after neoadjuvant

boxes: Oncotype on the specimen: N0 or 1–3 nodes
chemo by RS + menopausal status (TAILORx, RxPONDER)
high risk premenopausal: OFS + AI or tamoxifen
≥4 nodes or 1–3 + high risk: abemaciclib ×2 yr
pCR → complete 1 yr HP (pertuzumab if N+)
surgery → pembro to 1 yr, regardless of pCR

blocks.heading: Receptor definitions — ASCO/CAP
rows: HR-positive. ER-low (1–10%) behaves like TNBC — consider TNBC-type chemo/IO
No membrane staining. No HER2-directed therapy
Faint, incomplete membrane staining in ≤10% of cells. T-DXd-eligible in HR+ mBC after ET (DESTINY-Breast06)
IHC 1+ (faint, incomplete in >10%) or IHC 2+ / ISH−. Not HER2-positive — no trastuzumab benefit — but T-DXd works (DESTINY-Breast04/06)
blocks.footnote: Pathology reports must now distinguish 0-null from ultralow — ask for a re-read of an archival “IHC 0” before ruling out T-DXd. Scoring 0 vs 1+ is poorly reproducible; retest a metastatic biopsy.

blocks.heading: HER2-low / ultralow — T-DXd
rows: HER2-low, HR+ or HR−: OS 23.4 vs 16.8 (HR+ cohort 23.9 vs 17.5; PFS 10.1 vs 5.4)
HR+, low + ultralow: PFS 13.2 vs 8.1 (HR 0.62); OS immature

blocks.heading: Germline testing
items: ASCO/SSO 2024: offer BRCA1/2 testing to every patient diagnosed at ≤65 (stage I–III or de novo IV). Over 65: if TNBC, male, PARP-inhibitor candidate, or suggestive personal/family history. NCCN uses ≤50 plus family/personal criteria
Testing is treatment-changing: adjuvant olaparib (OlympiA), PARP inhibitor in mBC, and surgery choice (bilateral mastectomy, RRSO)
High penetrance: BRCA1 (TNBC-enriched) · BRCA2 (HR+, male BC) · PALB2 (manage like BRCA) · TP53 (avoid RT if possible) · PTEN · CDH1 (lobular + diffuse gastric)
Moderate penetrance: CHEK2, ATM — annual MRI screening; risk-reducing mastectomy is not indicated on the gene alone; RT is safe
Offer a multigene panel — not BRCA alone — when history suggests other genes

pages.subtitle: Page 2 — evidence by subtype and setting

blocks.heading: Early HR+ / HER2−
rows: TAILORx: RS 11–25 → ET alone non-inferior (9-yr iDFS 83.3 vs 84.3%). Age ≤50 with RS 16–25: chemo helps. RS ≥26 → chemo
RxPONDER (RS ≤25): postmenopausal — no benefit; premenopausal — 5-yr iDFS 93.9 vs 89.0% (likely an OFS effect)
SOFT/TEXT: OFS + exemestane best DFS. Final 15-yr: OS gain confined to high risk — age <35: 82.5 vs 77.9 vs 68.1% (E+OFS / T+OFS / T)
≥4 nodes, or 1–3 + grade 3, ≥5 cm or Ki-67 ≥20%. 7-yr iDFS 77.4 vs 70.9%; OS now significant (HR 0.84; 86.8 vs 85.0%)
Stage IIB–III, or IIA N0 with grade 3 (or grade 2 + high genomic risk/Ki-67 ≥20%). 5-yr iDFS HR 0.72 (+4.5 points); OS not yet significant

blocks.heading: Early HER2+
rows: APT (single-arm, ≤3 cm): TH → 10-yr iDFS 91.3%. ATEMPT: T-DM1 ×1 yr — 3-yr iDFS 97.8% but no less toxicity (46 vs 47%)
NeoSphere: pertuzumab raised pCR 29 → 46%. DESTINY-Breast11: T-DXd ×4 → THP vs ddAC → THP, pCR 67.3 vs 56.3%, grade ≥3 AE 38 vs 56%; T-DXd alone was inferior and closed
KATHERINE: T-DM1 ×14, iDFS HR 0.50, 7-yr OS 89.1 vs 84.4%. DESTINY-Breast05 (high risk): T-DXd vs T-DM1, 3-yr iDFS 92.4 vs 83.7% (HR 0.47); ILD 9.6%
APHINITY: iDFS HR 0.81; benefit is node-positive only (8-yr 86.1 vs 81.2%); OS not significant
ExteNET: neratinib ×1 yr, 5-yr iDFS 90.2 vs 87.7%; gain in HR+; no OS benefit; 40% grade 3 diarrhea without prophylaxis

blocks.heading: Early TNBC
rows: Stage II–III: pCR 64.8 vs 51.2%; 5-yr OS 86.6 vs 81.7%. Give pembrolizumab regardless of PD-L1 or pCR
Residual HER2− disease: capecitabine; TNBC OS HR 0.52
gBRCA with residual TNBC or ≥pT2/pN1: olaparib ×1 yr

blocks.heading: Metastatic HR+ — 1L CDK4/6 inhibitors
blocks.footnote: Ribociclib is the only CDK4/6i with OS benefit in every phase 3 — the preferred 1L agent. HR+/HER2+ mBC: PATINA added palbociclib to maintenance HP + ET after induction — PFS 44.3 vs 29.1 mo (HR 0.75), OS pending.

blocks.heading: Metastatic HR+ — sequencing
items: Endocrine-sensitive (de novo, or relapse >12 mo after adjuvant ET) → AI + CDK4/6i. Endocrine-resistant (on or ≤12 mo after adjuvant ET) → fulvestrant + CDK4/6i, or the inavolisib triplet if PIK3CA-mutant
Visceral crisis → chemotherapy first; otherwise endocrine-based therapy precedes chemo. Premenopausal/men: add GnRH agonist
Re-test ctDNA at each progression (ESR1 acquired on AI)

blocks.heading: Metastatic HER2+
rows: DESTINY-Breast09: T-DXd + pertuzumab vs THP, PFS 40.7 vs 26.9 (HR 0.56), OS immature, ILD 12%. CLEOPATRA (THP): OS 57.1 vs 40.8 — still reasonable
DESTINY-Breast03: T-DXd vs T-DM1, PFS 28.8 vs 6.8, OS HR 0.64
HER2CLIMB: tucatinib + trastuzumab + capecitabine, OS 21.9 vs 17.4, CNS-PFS 9.9 vs 4.2, active mets allowed · T-DXd active (DB-12)

blocks.heading: Metastatic TNBC
rows: Pembro + chemo (KEYNOTE-355): OS 23.0 vs 16.1, HR 0.73; no OS gain at CPS 1–9 · SG + pembro (ASCENT-04): PFS 11.2 vs 7.8, OS immature
Dato-DXd (TROPION-Breast02): PFS 10.8 vs 5.6, OS 23.7 vs 18.7 · SG (ASCENT-03): PFS 9.7 vs 6.9, OS immature
Olaparib (OlympiAD, PFS 7.0 vs 4.2) or talazoparib (EMBRACA, 8.6 vs 5.6) — neither improved OS

blocks.heading: Metastatic HR+ — after CDK4/6 by biomarker
rows: Elacestrant (EMERALD): ESR1m PFS 3.8 vs 1.9 (HR 0.55) · imlunestrant (EMBER-3): 5.5 vs 3.8 (HR 0.62); + abemaciclib 9.4 vs 5.5 (combo approved Sep 2026) · vepdegestrant (VERITAC-2, May 2026)
SERENA-6: ESR1m emerges before progression → switch AI to camizestrant, keep CDK4/6i: PFS 16.0 vs 9.2 (HR 0.44). Approved Sep 2026; OS immature
Inavolisib + palbo + fulv (INAVO120, endocrine-resistant): PFS 15.0 vs 7.3, OS 34.0 vs 27.0 (HR 0.67) · alpelisib + fulv (SOLAR-1): 11.0 vs 5.7, OS NS
T-DXd if HER2-low/ultralow (DB-04/06) · Sacituzumab (TROPiCS-02): OS 14.4 vs 11.2 · Dato-DXd (TROPION-Breast01): PFS HR 0.63 · gBRCA: PARPi

pages.subtitle: Page 3 — regimen dosing, toxicity and monitoring, key trials

blocks.heading: Early-stage dosing
rows: Doxorubicin 60 + cyclophosphamide 600 q14d ×4 (G-CSF) → paclitaxel 175 q14d ×4 or 80 weekly ×12
Carboplatin AUC 5 d1 + paclitaxel 80 d1, 8, 15 + pembrolizumab 200 mg q21d ×4 → AC (60/600) + pembro q21d ×4 → surgery → pembro ×9 (1 yr total)
Docetaxel 75 + carboplatin AUC 6 + trastuzumab 8 → 6 mg/kg ± pertuzumab 840 → 420 mg q21d ×6; HER2 therapy to 1 yr
Paclitaxel 80 + trastuzumab 4 → 2 mg/kg weekly ×12, then trastuzumab 6 mg/kg q3wk to 1 yr
AC q14d ×4 → paclitaxel 80 weekly ×12 + trastuzumab ± pertuzumab. Never HER2 agents concurrent with anthracycline
T-DM1 3.6 mg/kg q21d ×14 · T-DXd 5.4 mg/kg q21d ×14 (DB-05)
400 mg daily d1–21 q28d ×3 yr + NSAI
Tamoxifen 20 mg · anastrozole 1 · letrozole 2.5 · exemestane 25 mg daily · goserelin 3.6 mg SQ q4wk / leuprolide 3.75 mg q4wk
blocks.footnote: Doses mg/m² unless stated. Neratinib: loperamide prophylaxis or dose escalation from the start.

blocks.heading: Metastatic dosing
rows: Ribociclib 600 mg d1–21 q28d · palbociclib 125 mg d1–21 q28d · abemaciclib 150 mg BID continuous (200 BID alone) — with AI or fulvestrant
500 mg IM d1, 15, 29, then q28d. Premenopausal: add OFS to AI or fulvestrant
Elacestrant 345 mg daily · imlunestrant 400 mg daily · camizestrant 75 mg daily + CDK4/6i
400 mg BID, 4 days on / 3 off + fulvestrant
Inavolisib 9 mg daily + palbociclib + fulvestrant · alpelisib 300 mg daily + fulvestrant
10 mg + 25 mg daily; dexamethasone mouthwash for stomatitis
Docetaxel 75 (or weekly paclitaxel 80) + trastuzumab 8 → 6 mg/kg + pertuzumab 840 → 420 mg q21d; stop taxane after ~6 cycles, continue HP
5.4 mg/kg q21d (HER2+, low, ultralow) ± pertuzumab 1L. Highly emetogenic — 3-drug prophylaxis
Tucatinib 300 mg BID + capecitabine 1000 mg/m² BID d1–14 + trastuzumab 8 → 6 mg/kg q21d
10 mg/kg d1, d8 q21d (± pembro 200 q3wk)
Olaparib 300 mg BID · talazoparib 1 mg daily
Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q4wk (q12wk after 1 yr) or denosumab 120 mg SQ q4wk; dental review, Ca/vit D

blocks.heading: Surgical, radiation and special situations
items: Inflammatory (T4d): trimodality always — neoadjuvant systemic therapy → modified radical mastectomy + ALND → chest wall + nodal RT, even after pCR; no BCS, delayed reconstruction
BCS relative contraindications: Li-Fraumeni, active scleroderma/lupus, prior chest RT, large tumor-to-breast ratio. Mastectomy for gene carriers, prior mantle RT, or preference
Pregnancy: surgery any trimester; anthracycline chemo from the 2nd trimester; no endocrine, HER2, IO or RT until after delivery
Male breast cancer: mostly HR+, BRCA2-enriched; tamoxifen preferred; an AI needs a GnRH agonist
Lymphedema ~5% after SLNB, highest after ALND + nodal RT · BIA-ALCL (textured implants): cytology, then remove capsule + implant

blocks.heading: Toxicity and monitoring
items: T-DXd ILD (10–15% across trials, fatal cases): baseline + serial chest CT on therapy, ask about cough/dyspnea at every visit. Grade 1: hold until resolved (same dose if ≤28 days), consider steroids. Grade ≥2: stop permanently + prompt systemic steroids
HER2 agents — cardiac: LVEF at baseline and q3 months. Hold trastuzumab for ≥16% absolute drop, or below normal with ≥10% drop; recheck in 4 wk
Ribociclib: QTc — ECG baseline (start only if QTcF <450) and ~day 14; electrolytes; never with tamoxifen; LFTs + CBC q2wk ×2 cycles
Abemaciclib: diarrhea — loperamide at the first loose stool; CBC/LFTs q2wk ×2 mo; VTE, ILD. Palbociclib: neutropenia, CBC d1 + d15 of cycles 1–2

Alpelisib / capivasertib / inavolisib: hyperglycemia — fasting glucose + HbA1c first, optimize diabetes; glucose weekly-to-biweekly in month 1; metformin first-line; rash (alpelisib: antihistamine prophylaxis)
Sacituzumab: neutropenia (grade ≥3 ~50%), diarrhea; UGT1A1*28 homozygotes at higher risk. Dato-DXd: stomatitis and keratitis — steroid mouthwash + eye care
Tamoxifen: VTE, endometrial cancer (annual gyn review); avoid paroxetine/fluoxetine (CYP2D6). AI: DEXA baseline + q1–2 yr
Surveillance: H&P q6–12 mo ×5 yr, annual mammogram; no routine markers or imaging

blocks.heading: Key trials
rows: Pembro + neoadjuvant chemo, stage II–III TNBC — 5-yr OS 86.6 vs 81.7%
T-DXd, HER2-low after chemo / low + ultralow after ET
T-DXd 2L vs T-DM1 / 1L + pertuzumab vs THP
T-DXd for residual HER2+ disease / neoadjuvant T-DXd → THP
ctDNA-guided switch to camizestrant before progression
SG in refractory TNBC / + pembro 1L CPS ≥10
